parts:
Hi,

I was going to run a model linking to the logistic regression function. My model has both a moderator and a mediator.
However, when I try to run the model I get an error saying

"lavaan ERROR: some variables have no values (only missings) or no variance"

for the moderation (which I have noted using the "Behavior:Support" line in my model)

it says that there are no values for this variable (although I do not want it to be a variable. I want to signal a moderation between Behavior and Support)

I'd be thankful for any kind of advice of how to write a moderation for logistic regression in lavaan, thank you!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Lavaan
parts: I want to signal a moderation between Behavior and Support

Are they both of class numeric in your data.frame?  You cannot use the colon operator to automate interactions between categorical predictor(s); you would need to create the dummy/effects/contrast codes yourself.  
lavaan's ?model.syntax has its own operators/modifiers, which do not follow all the same rules as you find for ?formula objects.
I'd be thankful for any kind of advice of how to write a moderation for logistic regression in lavaan

lavaan does not currently support the logit link, only the probit link.  The ?lavOptions help page should be updated when it is available again (for MML estimation).
